title: Patient Payment Plan Catch-Up Payments
content:
**Patient Services Center guidance — catch-up payments on a past-due Patient Payment Plan**

## Catch-up rule

A catch-up payment brings a past-due plan current in one payment, is recorded against the installment most recently recorded as missed, and is taken off the plan balance.

The catch-up payment is taken by hand and counts as an installment payment toward the missed installments, never as an extra payment, even on a tier whose installments are otherwise collected automatically.

The catch-up amount is fixed only after the installment most recently recorded as missed carries its late-fee entry on the plan.

Put another way: while the plan history shows no late-fee entry carrying the due date of the installment most recently recorded as missed, no catch-up amount is fixed for the plan.

The catch-up is the patient's own payment, made at the patient's request on a Patient Payment Plan in past due status.

## Payment tool: `pay_payment_plan_past_due_400c78cb`

**Capability.** Records a catch-up payment on the patient's own past-due payment plan and brings it current. One call records exactly one installment payment dated today, taken by phone with the method the patient chooses and tied to the most recent missed installment by its due date; the amount is taken off the balance owed under the plan and the agreement is marked current (active) again.

**How it is invoked.** The tool belongs to the patient. The agent unlocks it for the patient with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves (the patient) then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the tool name `pay_payment_plan_past_due_400c78cb` and its arguments.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_plan_id` | The reference number of the patient's payment plan agreement, read to the patient from the payment plan lookup | Identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | The due date of the most recent missed installment the catch-up payment is recorded against, as shown on that missed installment in the plan history | YYYY-MM-DD; no time of day, no time zone |
| `amount` | The catch-up amount being paid | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | How the patient pays | One of `card` (a credit or debit card read out on the call), `ach` (a bank transfer from a checking or savings account the patient gives), `check` (a mailed paper check the patient commits to), `cash` (cash handed in at a clinic front desk), `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings or flexible spending account card) |

**Return.** A confirmation of the payment containing `payment_id` (reference of the payment entry), `payment_plan_id` (the plan paid), `installment_due_date` (the missed installment the payment is recorded against, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (the amount paid, USD with 2 decimal places), `payment_method` (the method used), `plan_balance` (the balance still owed net of this payment, USD with 2 decimal places) and `plan_status`, which is always `active` once the payment is recorded.

## Contract questions

**How many payments does one run record?** One installment payment, for the amount given, recorded against the installment named by `installment_due_date`.

**What does the patient see afterwards?** The new plan balance and the plan status, straight away.
